# gramlot-js-server 0.3.31 — complete serverless package

- `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless` publishes `src/absent-packages.js`. In 0.3.30 the file was missing from the package, so every export from the npm package failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.
- A test packs the serverless package and checks that every relative import of a published module is published.

Qualification: full test suite green on GitHub Actions (Node and Bun, serverless exports and gallery in Chromium).
